battle.name: 八國聯軍戰爭
battle.brief: 八國聯軍戰爭於1900年爆發，聯軍在北京與天津一帶進行圍攻，大沽口攻防尤為關鍵。英國皇家海軍投入鐵甲艦（Ironclad，1862年），以重裝甲與大口徑火炮執行海上封鎖、護航及沿岸火力支援，象徵遠洋主力艦在戰役中的作用。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 鐵甲艦是英國皇家海軍遠洋戰鬥力量的核心裝甲艦種，負責護航、封鎖與岸轟，並為後續主力艦的海上控制提供基礎。

countries: 1900年的「八國聯軍」由大英帝國（含英屬印度部隊）、美國、法蘭西第三共和國、德意志帝國、俄羅斯帝國、日本帝國、義大利王國與奧匈帝國組成，的另一方是大清帝國。五月，多國先遣隊先在天津與大沽集結，組成約二千人的塞西莫遠征軍；因此最初的數字不是八國全部同時投入的人數。多國海艦由渤海進入，以艦炮支援陸戰隊奪取大沽砲台；六月十七日至二十八日，大沽諸砲台與北塘一線的抵抗先後被清除，七月聯軍攻入天津，八月再會師攻北京。各國名義上屬於同聯軍，實際上多由本國指揮官帶隊，命令格式、語言與後方體系不一，初期協調尤其吃力；至北京戰役時，地面兵力通常估計約兩萬，但數字會因是否計入海軍、運輸隊及留守部隊而異。任務也由救援各國駐京使館，擴展為打通天津至北京的交通線、控制鐵路與鞏固已奪城市。
countriesEn: The Eight-Nation Alliance of 1900 consisted of the British Empire, including troops from British India, the United States, the French Third Republic, the German Empire, the Russian Empire, the Empire of Japan, the Kingdom of Italy, and Austria-Hungary; the opposing state was the Qing Empire. In May, contingents from several countries first assembled at Tianjin and Taku to form Seymour’s Expedition of about 2,000 men, so the initial figure did not represent the entire simultaneous commitment of all eight powers. Warships entered from the Bohai Sea and used naval gunfire to support troops in taking the Taku forts. Between 17 and 28 June, resistance at the Taku forts and along the Peitao line was progressively overcome; the allies entered Tianjin in July and converged on Beijing in August. Although formally united, the national contingents generally remained under their own commanders, with different command practices, languages, and support systems, which made coordination especially difficult at first. By the fighting for Beijing, the ground force is commonly estimated at about 20,000, although estimates differ according to whether naval, transport, and garrison personnel are included. The mission expanded from relieving the foreign legations in Beijing to opening the communications between Tianjin and Beijing, controlling the railway, and consolidating captured cities.
people: 海軍少將愛德華·塞西莫是第一次遠征的指揮者。他於五月中旬率約二千人的混合縱隊自天津北上，六月十三日在廊坊遭清軍與義和團武裝阻擊，本人受傷，縱隊遂退回大沽。塞西莫於六月二十八日再率主力向北京推進；英國陸軍准將阿瑟·加斯利則率後續部隊參與救援，並於八月五日指揮北塘戰役。美國海軍陸戰隊少校 Myron H. McCalla 率領美國分遣隊及駐京使館守軍，參與接應使館的作戰。清軍方面，北塘防務由聶士成指揮，兵力逾一萬；北京一線則有董福祥所部及若干禁軍、綠營單位負責抵抗。慈禧在聯軍攻入北京時率朝廷與近衛離京，西遷西安。德國將軍阿爾弗雷德·馮·瓦爾德塞於九月抵達中國，接任八國聯軍最高指揮，負責整編占領、追擊與後續遠征。塞西莫、加斯利、麥卡拉代表快速進入的救援指揮體系，聶士成與董福祥代表各自獨立的清軍防區，瓦爾德塞則象徵佔領北京後才形成的跨國統籌層次。
peopleEn: Rear Admiral Sir Edward Seymour commanded the first relief expedition. In mid-May he led a mixed column of about 2,000 men north from Tianjin. After Qing troops and Boxer armed forces blocked his route at Langfang on 13 June, Seymour was wounded and the column fell back to Taku. On 28 June he began advancing toward Beijing again with the main relief force. Brigadier-General Arthur Gaselee led reinforcements, participated in the relief, and commanded the Battle of Beicang on 5 August. Major Myron H. McCalla of the United States Marine Corps led the American contingent and the legation guards in operations connected with relieving the legations. On the Qing side, Nie Shicheng commanded more than 10,000 troops in the Beicang defenses, while Dong Fuxiang’s troops and units drawn from the imperial guards and Green Standard defended the Beijing area. When the allies entered Beijing, Empress Dowager Cixi left the court and its close guard for Xi’an. General Alfred von Waldersee arrived in China in September and assumed overall command of the Eight-Nation Alliance, organizing the occupation, pursuit, and later expeditions. Seymour and Gaselee represented the rapidly assembled relief command, McCalla led the American contingent within that structure, Nie and Dong commanded separate Qing defensive sectors, and Waldersee embodied the multinational coordination formed only after the capture of Beijing.
kits: 聯軍的武器並未統一，但各型號都已在1900年以前列裝。英軍使用 Martini-Henry Mk I 與 Short Lee Enfield Mk III 步槍，英屬印度部隊亦大量使用 Lee-Enfield 系步槍；美軍以 Springfield M1895、口徑 .30-40 為主力；法軍使用 Lebel Modèle 1886；德軍使用 Gewehr 88 Modell 1888；俄軍使用 Mosin-Nagant M1891；日軍使用1898年制式的 Type 18 三八式步槍；義軍使用 Carcano M1891；奧匈軍使用 Mannlicher Modell 1888/90。Martini-Henry 與原版 Lebel 是單發步槍，其餘多數為手動拉膛步槍。聯軍砲兵也不是共同口徑，已列裝並可見於遠征序列者包括法軍 Canon de 75 Modèle 1886、德軍 7.7 cm FK 96、日軍 75 mm Type 26 野戰砲與俄軍47公厘三吋野戰砲；大沽與北塘各砲台另有固定岸防重砲。清軍步兵主要使用八八式步槍。各國彈藥分別供應，常見口徑包括英軍 .303、美軍 .30-40、法軍8公厘 Lebel、德軍7.92公厘、俄軍7.62公厘、日軍6.5公厘，以及義軍和奧匈軍的8.8公厘。彈藥不能互通，後勤線又各自延伸至天津與大沽， speed mismatch 直接影響協同射擊與連續進攻。
kitsEn: The allies did not use a common inventory, but every model listed had entered service before 1900. British troops used the Martini-Henry Mk I and Short Lee Enfield Mk III rifles, while British Indian units also carried large numbers of Lee-Enfield-pattern rifles. The principal American weapon was the Springfield M1895 in .30-40 caliber. French troops used the Lebel Modèle 1886, Germans used the Gewehr 88 Modell 1888, Russians used the Mosin-Nagant M1891, and Japanese troops used the Type 18 rifle adopted in 1898. Italian troops carried the Carcano M1891, while Austro-Hungarian troops used the Mannlicher Modell 1888/90. The Martini-Henry and original Lebel were single-shot rifles; most of the others were manually operated bolt-action rifles. Allied artillery was likewise not standardized. Weapons already in service and available within expeditionary columns included the French Canon de 75 Modèle 1886, German 7.7 cm FK 96, Japanese 75 mm Type 26 field gun, and Russian 47 mm three-inch field gun; the forts at Taku and Peitao also mounted fixed heavy coastal guns. Qing infantry relied chiefly on the Type 88 rifle. Ammunition remained national rather than interchangeable, with common calibers including British .303, American .30-40, French 8 mm Lebel, German 7.92 mm, Russian 7.62 mm, Japanese 6.5 mm, and 8.8 mm for the Italian and Austro-Hungarian rifles. Separate ammunition networks extending through Tianjin and Taku created speed differences that directly affected coordinated fire and sustained advances.
tactics: 第一支遠征隊以縱隊沿天津至通州方向行軍，因情報不足、連續行軍造成的疲勞，以及各國分隊彼此距離過遠，在廊坊失去主動；退回大沽後，聯軍改以海軍炮火壓制大沽砲台射界，再由登岸部隊奪取砲位，使守軍無法集中火砲射擊。第二次推進時，聯軍先利用天津外圍道路與北寧鐵路集中兵力，於七月十四日至十五日以野戰砲控制城頭，由工兵破壞城門及牆段，步兵趁煙塵突入，經激烈巷戰迫使清軍向北塘方向撤退。八月五日北塘戰役中，加斯利所部約二千人在砲兵支援下建立正面陣線，讓清軍中央部隊反覆衝鋒，再以側翼火力破壞其步兵密集隊形，終使清軍中線崩潰。八月十四日至十五日攻北京時，聯軍先以重砲射擊城牆與內城，日軍與德軍各在一部城牆實施夜襲攀城，其餘部隊經打開的城門或缺口進入。奪城過程仍呈現各軍各自選路、各自設定攻擊目標的特徵，命令需經本國參謀反覆轉達；這使突破速度不一致，也造成部分部隊集中遲到。
tacticsEn: The first relief column marched in formation toward Tongzhou, but unreliable intelligence, fatigue from continuous marching, and excessive separation between national detachments deprived it of initiative at Langfang. After withdrawing to Taku, the allies changed methods: naval gunfire suppressed the firing arcs of the forts, while landing detachments occupied battery positions and prevented the defenders from bringing their guns to bear on a single target. During the second advance, the allies concentrated along the roads outside Tianjin and the railway to Beicang. Between 14 and 15 July, field artillery dominated the walls, engineers breached gates and wall sections, and infantry entered under cover of smoke. In close fighting, the Qing troops withdrew toward Beicang. At the Battle of Beicang on 5 August, Gaselee’s roughly 2,000 men formed a front supported by artillery. They allowed the Qing central formations to charge repeatedly, then used flanking fire to disrupt the increasingly dense infantry formations until the Qing center collapsed. During the assault on Beijing on 14 and 15 August, heavy guns first engaged the walls and inner city. Japanese and German units scaled separate sections of the wall during nocturnal attacks, while other contingents entered through opened gates or breaches. The assault still showed each force selecting its own route and tactical objective, with orders passing repeatedly through national staffs. The result was uneven speed and the late arrival of some concentrated troops.
data: 可核對的戰役日誌如下：五月十日前後，多國先遣隊在天津集結；六月十三日，塞西莫縱隊在廊坊受挫並退回大沽；六月十七日至二十八日，大沽諸砲台及北塘一線完成肅清；六月二十八日，塞西莫率第二次遠征出發；七月十四日至十五日，天津失守；七月下旬，聯軍推進至通州；八月五日，北塘清軍戰敗；八月十四日至十五日，北京被攻入，各國使館圍困解除；九月，瓦爾德塞抵達並統整佔領軍；至1901年9月7日，清廷與列強代表簽署辛丑條約。初始遠征約二千人，北京攻城時通常估計約兩萬人。天津至大沽約五十公里，天津至北塘約二十公里，北塘至北京約一百至一百二十公里；糧秣、馬匹飼料、煤與備份彈藥依賴天津、大沽及北寧鐵路分段運輸。步兵野戰攜行量多在百發上下，各國備彈另以箱件送至前方，長距離行軍因此受到車運、畜力與道路狀況限制。各國檔案的聯軍傷亡分別登錄，清軍各部隊又無一致的總 casualty 簿冊，現存數字不能可靠拼成單一精確傷亡總數，因此本實錄只列可核對的日期、編制、路線與補給條件。
dataEn: A verifiable campaign chronology runs as follows: around 10 May, contingents from several powers assembled at Tianjin; on 13 June, Seymour’s column was checked at Langfang and withdrew to Taku; between 17 and 28 June, the Taku forts and the Peitao line were cleared; on 28 June, Seymour began the second relief advance; between 14 and 15 July, Tianjin was captured; in late July, the allies reached Tongzhou; on 5 August, the Qing army was defeated at Beicang; on 14 and 15 August, Beijing was entered and the siege of the legations was relieved; in September, Waldersee arrived and reorganized the occupation force; and on 7 September 1901, Qing representatives and representatives of the powers signed the Boxer Protocol. The initial expedition numbered about 2,000 men, while the force assaulting Beijing is commonly estimated at about 20,000. The distance from Tianjin to Taku was approximately 50 kilometers, Tianjin to Beicang about 20 kilometers, and Beicang to Beijing roughly 100 to 120 kilometers. Food, animal fodder, coal, and reserve ammunition moved separately through Tianjin, Taku, and sections of the railway north from Tianjin. Infantry commonly carried on the order of one hundred rounds for the march, with national reserves delivered forward in boxes, making movement dependent on rail transport, draft animals, and road conditions. Allied casualties were recorded separately by each country, while the Qing units left no consistent overall casualty ledger. Existing figures therefore cannot be assembled reliably into one precise total, so this record confines itself to verifiable dates, organization, routes, and supply conditions.
cause: 戰爭由長期矛盾與1900年的連鎖危機共同造成。清廷在外交、財政與軍事改革上與列強的摩擦增加，列強要求更多駐兵權、鐵路與貿易保障，義和團則在直隸、山東迅速組成武裝，並獲得部分地方官默許或利用。清廷最初曾調兵剿滅，後又因局勢與外交壓力改變態度，使軍隊、地方武裝與列強武裝在同一區域內反覆接觸。直接引爆點之一是塞西莫率武裝遠征隊自天津向北京行進；沿途阻擊使第一次救援失敗。五月二十日前後，大沽海戰又使聯軍海艦受損，並把原本局限於地方軍隊與外國使館的衝突擴大為列強與清廷直接交戰。五月下旬開始，駐京各國使館被清軍及義和團武裝包圍，糧水與彈藥消耗使救援更為迫切；六月下旬，清廷分批對列強宣戰，使戰事正式升級。各國遠征軍缺乏統一指揮，清軍各部又分屬不同系統、互不支援，加上英、俄、日、德等國各有戰略與利益考量，使原本可以談判或局部停火的衝突迅速轉成持續數月的聯軍戰役。
causeEn: The war arose from long-term tensions combined with a chain of crises in 1900. Qing diplomacy, finance, and military reforms collided with foreign demands for broader rights of stationing, railway access, and commercial security. Boxer armed organizations expanded rapidly in Zhili and Shandong with the tacit support or political exploitation of some local officials. The court initially ordered troops against them but later changed course under military and diplomatic pressure, allowing Qing troops, armed organizations, and foreign contingents to collide repeatedly in the same districts. One immediate trigger was Seymour’s armed march from Tianjin toward Beijing; resistance along that route caused the first relief attempt to fail. An engagement at Taku around 20 May also damaged allied warships and widened a conflict previously concentrated among regional forces and foreign legations. From late May, Qing troops and Boxer armed units surrounded the foreign legations in Beijing, and dwindling food, water, and ammunition made relief increasingly urgent. In late June, the Qing court issued declarations of war against the powers in stages, formally turning the conflict into an interstate war. The allied expedition lacked a unified command, Qing formations belonged to separate systems and did not support one another, and the different strategic interests of Britain, Russia, Japan, Germany, and the other participants made negotiations or a localized ceasefire increasingly difficult.
impact: 直接影響是使館圍困解除、北京與天津落入聯軍控制，清廷一度遷往西安，1900年10月返回北京後，只能在聯軍駐軍、條約限制與地方軍隊失控的條件下維持統治。北寧鐵路沿線、天津砲台、北京使館區及其周邊警戒點因而成為聯軍長期控制與補給的核心，清廷對京畿軍事部署的自主能力因而下降。瓦爾德塞到任後，聯軍由單純救援轉為佔領、追擊和分路遠征，國際介入不再以使館安全為終點。清朝軍政並未因此瓦解，反而因袁世凱率北洋軍鎮壓直隸而取得更大政治與軍事權力，北洋系的裝備、訓練與規模在戰後繼續擴張。聯軍本身則顯示多國部隊在共同目標下可以運用火砲、機槍、鐵路與海上運輸協同攻城，也暴露翻譯、各國後勤和指揮權分散的限制。此役使日本獲得大型海外聯合作戰經驗並提高國際地位，也使列強在遠東的軍力部署與北京政治影響長期固定下來。
impactEn: The immediate effects were the relief of the legations, the occupation of Beijing and Tianjin, and the flight of the Qing court to Xi’an. After returning to Beijing in October 1900, the court could govern only under the conditions of foreign garrisons, treaty restrictions, and unreliable control over regional forces. The Beijing–Tianjin railway corridor, the Tianjin forts, the legation quarter, and their surrounding security points became the core of the allied occupation and supply system, reducing the Qing court’s freedom to deploy troops in the capital region. After Waldersee arrived, the alliance moved beyond relief toward occupation, pursuit, and separate expeditions, so the international intervention no longer ended with the safety of the legations. The Qing military order did not collapse; instead, Yuan Shikai’s suppression of armed forces in Zhili increased the political and military authority of the Beiyang Army, whose equipment, training, and strength continued to expand after the war. The allied campaign also showed that troops from several states could combine artillery, machine guns, railways, and maritime transport in a common assault, while exposing the limitations created by translation problems, separate logistics, and divided command. Japan acquired extensive experience in large overseas combined operations and increased its international standing, while the foreign presence and political influence in northern China became a lasting feature of the postwar settlement.
result: 從戰役階段看，聯軍在1900年8月已取得三項明確成果：大沽與北塘砲台被控制，天津與北京被占領，各國使館圍困解除；但戰爭並未在十五日完全終止。瓦爾德塞接管指揮後，分遣隊沿保定、山東與山西方向追擊清軍及仍持有武裝的義和團團體，十月以後的零星戰鬥仍造成傷亡，冬季氣候、飼料與道路又限制了深入。十一月保定一線再戰後，清廷地方軍隊逐步撤離京畿，零散抵抗延續至1901年。清廷於1900年10月回到北京，隨後由李鴻章等官員與列強代表談判，1901年9月7日簽署辛丑條約，規定四億五千萬兩銀子的賠款分三十九年支付，允許外國在使館區及北京至海口間的指定據點駐兵，並禁止反對外國的組織。條約簽訂標誌條約層面的結束，但聯軍佔領與駐防沒有立即撤除，部分部隊在華時間還延續到1901年末之後。結果因此分為兩個層次：1900年8月的軍事救援與奪城成功，以及1901年9月形成的政治、財政與駐軍安排；由於雙方總傷亡數字無法可靠核實，較準確的結論只宜保留在這些可核對的成果與日期上。
resultEn: In the operational phase, the allies achieved three definite results by August 1900: control of the Taku and Peitao forts, the capture of Tianjin and Beijing, and the relief of the foreign legations. The war did not, however, end completely on 15 August. After assuming command, Waldersee dispatched columns toward Baoding, Shandong, and Shanxi to pursue Qing troops and armed Boxer formations still holding weapons. Scattered fighting continued after October, causing further casualties, while winter weather, fodder shortages, and road conditions limited deeper advances. Following renewed fighting on the Baoding front in November, Qing forces gradually withdrew from the capital district, although isolated resistance continued into 1901. The Qing court returned to Beijing in October 1900 and subsequently negotiated through officials including Li Hongzhang and representatives of the powers. On 7 September 1901, the Boxer Protocol was signed, providing for an indemnity of 450 million taels to be paid over 39 years, permitting foreign troops in the legation quarter and at designated posts between Beijing and the sea, and prohibiting organizations opposed to foreign presence. The treaty marked the settlement at the diplomatic level, but the occupation and foreign garrisons did not end immediately; some units remained in China beyond the end of 1901. The result therefore had two levels: the military relief and capture achieved in August 1900, and the political, financial, and garrison arrangements created in September 1901. Because a reliable combined casualty total cannot be established, the defensible conclusion is confined to these verifiable outcomes and dates.
